question: When carrying image provenance through exemplar frame, crop, and box outputs, which fields and nullability conventions should I apply without breaking video rows?
expected_answer_elements: Add source_kind and source_ref as nullable string fields to exemplar_frames, exemplar_frame_crops, and exemplar_frame_boxes.
Use source_kind values video or image.
Use the video sequence identifier as source_ref for video rows and a mission-and-image composite reference for image rows.
Make source_frame_index and source_timestamp_ms nullable so image-origin rows can carry null temporal values while video rows continue to populate integers.
For box row construction, propagate source_kind and source_ref when present and default them to None when the upstream projection does not include them.
Keep source_kind and source_ref as additive optional fields placed after required fields so required FrameOutput constructor arguments remain required.

support: The UES3 conversation defines source_kind/source_ref semantics across all three output tables and nullable temporal fields.
Its follow-up preserves required FrameOutput fields by moving optional provenance fields after the required group.
The boxes follow-up adds nullable strings and rec.get-based None defaults in box row construction.

rationale: Context prevents schema drift, invented sentinel timestamps, and accidental weakening of required dataclass fields.
safety: No personal identifiers, external customer references, or credentials are included.
